Registry contents may be third-party or attacker-controlled, so returned item listings are UNTRUSTED. The description does not say registries are public-only; configured registries could be private, localhost, or intranet, so under the least-restrictive reading it may return non-public registry data, making it SECRET. This private-registry reach is not settled by the text.
